title: QueryReport
description: This schema defines the QueryReport entity. A QueryReport holds metadata about a report, along with the SQL Queries associated with it (linked via the Query entity's usage mechanism).

id.description: Unique identifier that identifies this QueryReport instance.

name.description: Name that identifies this QueryReport instance uniquely.

fullyQualifiedName.description: A unique name that identifies a QueryReport.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this QueryReport.

sourceUrl.description: Link to this report in the source system.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

impersonatedBy.description: Bot user that performed the action on behalf of the actual user.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this QueryReport.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

dataProducts.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.
